clips.title: The story
paras: In the Ruins of Stardust, a pale frost gathers on the bushes south of Astranaar. Night elven healers use the powder to cool intense fevers.

Stardust clings to shrubs in the Ruins of Stardust, south of Astranaar. The fine powder shines like frost. Lingering elemental spirits haunt the ruins, yet plants thrive among the broken stones and take in a rare glow. Night elven healers make the residue into poultices for dangerous, persistent fevers. They turn to it when ordinary salves and moonwell waters bring no full relief.
